_comment: TDD M4 reasoning slice 1, loss partition (strict): effort outside the known enum values is a diagnosed loss; strict rejects pre-IO with 400 translation_loss and zero upstream requests. GREEN on baseline and must stay GREEN after impl.
name: m4_reasoning_chat_responses_enum_mismatch_strict
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-chat".reasoning.effort]
supported = true
values = ["low", "medium"]
